text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the £400k salary limit was not checkable and the comparison is fragile.

- The result is a provisional model-only comparison: all material inputs are Olumi estimates, not figures you supplied. Small assumption changes could alter the ordering.
- Platform delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption; it is an Olumi estimate. Salary levels and onboarding effects also contribute uncertainty.
- The analysis did not test whether any hiring plan stays below **£400k/year**, because salary spend is modelled as a change rather than a comparable annual-spend level. It also assumes that maximising “shipped by Q3” is the aim, rather than a stated success threshold.
